The '''''Aurel Moon''''' was a [[Marcadian luxury cruiser]] used by the [[Columi/Legends|Columi]] brothers, [[Craitheus Qreph|Craitheus]] and [[Marvid Qreph]] to travel through the [[Chiloon Rift/Legends|Chiloon Rift]] and oversee their financial takeover of the nebula. When the Qreph brothers were negotiating with Lando Calrissian to buy his [[Sarnus Refinery]], the Qrephs took the ''Aurel Moon'' to the negotiations on [[Sarnus]]. After [[Firefight at the Blue Star casino|the capture]] of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], the Qreph brothers used ''Aurel Moon'' to travel to their [[Base Prime|secret base]].
